summary: Iteration 2 – Rozio-Killer Phase 2 (voice + PDF RAG + embed script + Twilio fallback). All 9 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend widget voice UI, embed snippet card, admin panel and demo dashboard flows all working. Prior iteration-1 bugs (chat/escalate + booking/confirm ObjectId 500s) are now FIXED. Twilio call falls back to mocked status as expected (empty TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER).
backend_tests_passed: POST /api/voice/stt → accepts multipart file upload, returns structured JSON (200/500)
POST /api/knowledge/upload → PDF extracted (reportlab-generated test.pdf), files list returns record with size>0
POST /api/chat/stream (session, tenant user_id=demo) → SSE deltas streamed, no error event
frontend_tests_passed: embed-copy-btn clickable (writeText perm denied in headless is env limitation, not a bug)
color-bubble input update dispatched, PUT /me/profile succeeded
admin@rozio-killer.com login → /admin, Client Database table renders (4 clients incl demo)
No JS console errors on /dashboard or /admin (only 1 benign clipboard permission error in headless)
critical_code_review_comments: Widget.jsx MediaRecorder handlers use onMouseDown/onMouseUp — works for desktop hold-to-talk, but mouseleave while pressed will not stop recording; consider adding onMouseLeave→stopRecording.

server.py embed_loader hardcodes fallback frontend URL when FRONTEND_URL env is missing — env var is not currently set; loader still emits correct public URL, but adding FRONTEND_URL to /app/backend/.env would be cleaner.
voice_stt writes uploaded audio to /tmp with the client-supplied filename appended — safe due to uuid prefix, but consider using tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile.
chat_stream injects up to 5 PDFs × 6000 chars each into the system prompt — can exceed token budget for large PDFs; consider a rudimentary retrieval (top-k by keyword).
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 1 tiny reportlab-generated test.pdf under demo@client.com. Reset bubble_color back to #48BB78 after color-change test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints for voice/tts, voice/stt, embed loader (valid+invalid), chat/escalate (mocked twilio), PDF RAG upload, chat/stream, and admin/demo logins are green. Iteration-1 ObjectId serialization bugs are gone. Test file backend_test.py in /app/backend/tests/ is pytest-native and reusable. Twilio remains mocked because TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER is intentionally empty per user setup.
